headline: UPSC Chairman Dr Ajay Kumar, along with members of the Commission, called on President Smt Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati...
content: UPSC Chairman Dr Ajay Kumar, along with members of the Commission, called on President Smt Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan and presented the Commission’s 76th Annual Report, together with the commemorative coins and postage stamp issued to mark the UPSC’s centenary year.

headline: PM Shri Narendra Modi begins a two-day Gujarat visit today.
content: PM Shri Narendra Modi begins a two-day Gujarat visit today. In Banaskantha he will visit the ET-IVF Laboratory and dedicate the Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre at Bhildi, then launch projects worth over ₹14,000 crore, including the foundation stone of Ahmedabad Metro Phase-2A (Airport Extension) and Phase-2B (GIFT City Extension), and flag off two train services.

headline: In Ekta Nagar, Kevadia, PM Modi will inaugurate Bharat Parv 2026 at about 5 PM and witness Ekta Prakash Parv and Narmada Aarti.
content: In Ekta Nagar, Kevadia, PM Modi will inaugurate Bharat Parv 2026 at about 5 PM and witness Ekta Prakash Parv and Narmada Aarti. On 31 October he will pay tributes at the Statue of Unity, launch projects worth over ₹400 crore and attend Rashtriya Ekta Diwas marking Sardar Patel’s 151st birth anniversary, with ‘Vande Mataram’ as the theme and the parade highlighting security forces’ successes against Left-Wing Extremism.

headline: Vice-President Shri C.P. Radhakrishnan is on a day-long visit to Tamil Nadu today.
content: Vice-President Shri C.P. Radhakrishnan is on a day-long visit to Tamil Nadu today. He will offer floral tributes at Pasumpon in Ramanathapuram on Pasumpon Muthuramalinga Thevar Jayanthi and attend the Golden Jubilee celebrations and 39th Convocation of Gandhigram Rural Institute in Dindigul.

headline: The PM Modi will release the 24th instalment of PM-KISAN from Banaskantha today, transferring over ₹18,690 crore to more than 9.
content: The PM Modi will release the 24th instalment of PM-KISAN from Banaskantha today, transferring over ₹18,690 crore to more than 9.34 crore farmers through DBT. He will also dedicate 521 units built under the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund and inaugurate 12 horticulture clusters; over ₹4.47 lakh crore was paid in the first 23 instalments.

headline: The Ayushman Vay Vandana Yojana, which gives all citizens aged 70 and above health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family a year...
content: The Ayushman Vay Vandana Yojana, which gives all citizens aged 70 and above health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family a year under AB PM-JAY, completed two years. It has facilitated over 23 lakh hospital admissions worth ₹5,668 crore; leading treatments include cataract surgery (4.71 lakh) and haemodialysis (about 3 lakh).

headline: Indian developers have secured 23 offtake contracts for over 5.
content: Indian developers have secured 23 offtake contracts for over 5.5 lakh tonnes a year of green hydrogen and derivatives under the National Green Hydrogen Mission, with over 70% meant for exports, driving about ₹90,000 crore of investment, Union Minister Pralhad Joshi said.

headline: NCCF’s e-Samyukti digital platform has enabled procurement of about 38 lakh tonnes of produce from over 43 lakh farmers,...
content: NCCF’s e-Samyukti digital platform has enabled procurement of about 38 lakh tonnes of produce from over 43 lakh farmers, with more than ₹13,000 crore transferred to them. Procurement of 324 lakh tonnes worth about ₹90,962 crore is expected under the Rabi MSPs for 2027-28.

headline: ESIC has extended its New Amnesty Scheme 2025, a one-time dispute resolution scheme for employers under the ESI Act, till 31...
content: ESIC has extended its New Amnesty Scheme 2025, a one-time dispute resolution scheme for employers under the ESI Act, till 31 December 2026. The scheme had run from 1 October 2025 to 30 September 2026.

headline: Education Minister Pralhad Joshi inaugurated the new academic building of the National Institute of Educational Planning and...
content: Education Minister Pralhad Joshi inaugurated the new academic building of the National Institute of Educational Planning and Administration (NIEPA) in New Delhi and launched the IKS Panchatantra Pariyojana to bring India’s knowledge traditions into education and nurture values and critical thinking among young learners.

headline: The Maharashtra government released ₹4,000 crore under the Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Farmers’ Loan Waiver Scheme, 2026,...
content: The Maharashtra government released ₹4,000 crore under the Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Farmers’ Loan Waiver Scheme, 2026, approved by the Cabinet on 2 June. The State has made a total provision of ₹20,552 crore for the scheme in 2026-27.

headline: Chairing the 93rd General Council meeting of the National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC), Union Cooperation...
content: Chairing the 93rd General Council meeting of the National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC), Union Cooperation Minister Amit Shah called for a 25-year roadmap for the corporation. NCDC reported a net profit of ₹1,475 crore, a 99.84% recovery rate and zero net NPA.

headline: Amit Shah spoke to the Chief Ministers of Andhra Pradesh, Puducherry, Odisha and Chhattisgarh after Cyclone Arnab and said...
content: Amit Shah spoke to the Chief Ministers of Andhra Pradesh, Puducherry, Odisha and Chhattisgarh after Cyclone Arnab and said an Inter-Ministerial Central Team will be sent to assess the damage. AP CM N. Chandrababu Naidu put the State’s preliminary loss at ₹4,600 crore and announced ₹1,500 per coconut and oil palm tree as compensation.

headline: In Odisha, 59,028 people, including 11,882 in Ganjam, have been evacuated as Arnab’s remnants hit nine districts; 313 rescue...
content: In Odisha, 59,028 people, including 11,882 in Ganjam, have been evacuated as Arnab’s remnants hit nine districts; 313 rescue teams of NDRF, ODRAF and Fire Services are deployed. About 300 villages in Ganjam were hit and 70 marooned, and an Indian Coast Guard helicopter began airlifting stranded people.

headline: The Election Commission revised the SIR schedule in Maharashtra, Delhi, Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, Telangana and Nagaland.
content: The Election Commission revised the SIR schedule in Maharashtra, Delhi, Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, Telangana and Nagaland. In Delhi, claims and objections can now be filed till 25 November instead of 30 October, with the final roll on 22 December; in Maharashtra the claims deadline is 13 November and the final roll 30 November.

headline: CBSE said Class 10 students of the 2028 batch will take five compulsory subjects with an optional skill subject that can...
content: CBSE said Class 10 students of the 2028 batch will take five compulsory subjects with an optional skill subject that can help them pass even if they fail in mathematics, science or social science. Vocational education stays compulsory through ‘Kaushal Vikas’ or one of 22 skill subjects.

headline: Pioxaniliprole, developed by PI Industries, has been registered by the Central Insecticides Board as the first insecticide...
content: Pioxaniliprole, developed by PI Industries, has been registered by the Central Insecticides Board as the first insecticide molecule discovered in India. It is approved against pests in rice, chilli, tomato and Bengal gram and will reach the market this Rabi season.

headline: The Health Ministry has barred the import of medicines with less than one year of remaining shelf life under the Drugs...
content: The Health Ministry has barred the import of medicines with less than one year of remaining shelf life under the Drugs (Thirteenth Amendment) Rules, 2026, effective 28 October. Biological drugs and radiopharmaceuticals may be imported with 60% of their labelled shelf life left.

headline: The 14th International Tourism Mart opened at Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh, and runs till 31 October.
content: The 14th International Tourism Mart opened at Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh, and runs till 31 October. Tourism Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat said domestic tourist visits to the North Eastern States rose from 95.65 lakh in 2019 to 1.51 crore in 2025.

headline: Delhi recorded its coldest October day in four years as Safdarjung’s maximum settled at 25.
content: Delhi recorded its coldest October day in four years as Safdarjung’s maximum settled at 25.4°C, 5.6 degrees below normal. IMD has issued a red alert for very heavy to extremely heavy rain in Bihar today as Arnab’s remnant moves north, with an orange alert for East UP, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal and Sikkim.

headline: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini has announced an increase in sugarcane prices for farmers over the next two years.
content: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini has announced an increase in sugarcane prices for farmers over the next two years. The price will be raised to 430 rupees per quintal for the 2026-27 season and further increased to 450 rupees per quintal for the 2027-28 season.

headline: Haryana Governor Professor Ashim Kumar Ghosh chaired the 83rd meeting of the Governing Body of the Kurukshetra Development...
content: Haryana Governor Professor Ashim Kumar Ghosh chaired the 83rd meeting of the Governing Body of the Kurukshetra Development Board to review preparations for the upcoming International Gita Jayanti celebrations. The festival will be held in Kurukshetra from 5th to 25th of December.

headline: Heavy rain continued across Chhattisgarh under the influence of Cyclone Arnab.
content: Heavy rain continued across Chhattisgarh under the influence of Cyclone Arnab. As a precautionary measure, schools in several districts of the state have been closed.

headline: The Supreme Court Collegium headed by CJI Surya Kant, with Justices Vikram Nath and B.
content: The Supreme Court Collegium headed by CJI Surya Kant, with Justices Vikram Nath and B.V. Nagarathna, approved the appointment of nine advocates as judges of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh, including Vishal Sharma, Namgyal Wangchuk, Tabasum Zafar, Pranav Kohli and Anupam Raina.

headline: P.B. Rangarao has taken charge as Director (Operations) of Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL).
content: P.B. Rangarao has taken charge as Director (Operations) of Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL). He was earlier CEO of HAL’s Helicopter Complex; he joined HAL as a design trainee in 1995 and helped operationalise the new helicopter factory at Tumakuru.

headline: Trent Ltd has appointed Bahram Vakil, co-founder of law firm AZB & Partners, as its chairman from 12 November.
content: Trent Ltd has appointed Bahram Vakil, co-founder of law firm AZB & Partners, as its chairman from 12 November. Noel Tata, associated with the company since 1997, will retire as chairman and director on 11 November, in line with the Tata Group’s age-related policy, and become chairman emeritus.

headline: The Supreme Court said banks and financial institutions should compensate “digital arrest” victims at least for the amount...
content: The Supreme Court said banks and financial institutions should compensate “digital arrest” victims at least for the amount lost if a lapse in due diligence is found, and may also face prosecution. The Bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana will examine RBI’s proposed KYC Amendment Directions, 2026, due to be notified by 30 November.

headline: The Supreme Court orally observed that the Ministry of Corporate Affairs has “completely hijacked” the NCLT and NCLAT and...
content: The Supreme Court orally observed that the Ministry of Corporate Affairs has “completely hijacked” the NCLT and NCLAT and called for full autonomy for their presidents, asking them to submit proposals within four weeks and suggesting recruitment of staff through UPSC or SSC.

headline: The Supreme Court struck down as unconstitutional Karnataka’s 2022 Act that validated the 2011 KPSC selection for 362 Group...
content: The Supreme Court struck down as unconstitutional Karnataka’s 2022 Act that validated the 2011 KPSC selection for 362 Group A and B gazetted posts, a process it said was riddled with “rampant corruption and blatant nepotism”. The Bench of Justices J.B. Pardiwala and K. Vinod Chandran called the law “stillborn”.

headline: The Supreme Court cancelled the anticipatory bail of IPS officer Srinath M. Joshi in an alleged extortion case linked to the...
content: The Supreme Court cancelled the anticipatory bail of IPS officer Srinath M. Joshi in an alleged extortion case linked to the Karnataka Lokayukta, and directed him to surrender within three weeks.

headline: The Allahabad High Court granted bail to SP leader Azam Khan and his son Abdullah Azam Khan in the dual PAN card case and...
content: The Allahabad High Court granted bail to SP leader Azam Khan and his son Abdullah Azam Khan in the dual PAN card case and suspended their sentences, but refused to stay their conviction.

headline: The CBI registered an FIR against Chandra Proteco Ltd and its directors Ranjeet Gupta, Anilesh Gupta and Aparna Gupta for an...
content: The CBI registered an FIR against Chandra Proteco Ltd and its directors Ranjeet Gupta, Anilesh Gupta and Aparna Gupta for an alleged ₹210.13 crore bank fraud on a complaint by Indian Bank, and searched premises in Prayagraj. The firm had availed credit facilities of ₹541.46 crore from a six-bank consortium.

headline: The Enforcement Directorate said it is probing alleged cross-border transfers of about ₹5,000 crore using cryptocurrency,...
content: The Enforcement Directorate said it is probing alleged cross-border transfers of about ₹5,000 crore using cryptocurrency, mainly stablecoins, after FEMA searches in Bengaluru and Madhya Pradesh on 27 October. It alleged FEMA contraventions of about ₹4,600 crore by RPFAS Technologies, which runs Mudrex.

headline: The Kolkata City Sessions Court has remanded former West Bengal Minister Indranil Sen to police custody until 10th of next...
content: The Kolkata City Sessions Court has remanded former West Bengal Minister Indranil Sen to police custody until 10th of next month in connection with an alleged financial irregularities case. He was arrested by Kolkata Police.

headline: Addressing the 13th ADMM-Plus in Cebu, Philippines, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said India is ready to share its...
content: Addressing the 13th ADMM-Plus in Cebu, Philippines, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said India is ready to share its “battle-tested” counter-terrorism expertise with ASEAN partners, calling Operation Sindoor a declaration of India’s clear approach against state-sponsored terrorism. He described India as a “trusted net security provider”.

headline: After concluding his engagements at the ADMM-Plus, Rajnath Singh visited a Gurudwara and a Hindu temple in Cebu and met...
content: After concluding his engagements at the ADMM-Plus, Rajnath Singh visited a Gurudwara and a Hindu temple in Cebu and met members of the Indian diaspora in the Philippines.

headline: MoS Defence Sanjay Seth will inaugurate VISV-2026 (Vision, Innovation, Synergy, Values), organised by DRDO with the Centre...
content: MoS Defence Sanjay Seth will inaugurate VISV-2026 (Vision, Innovation, Synergy, Values), organised by DRDO with the Centre for Joint Warfare Studies, in New Delhi today. Themed ‘Showcasing Defence Capabilities, Strengthening Global Partnerships’, it will showcase India’s defence technologies.

headline: INS Trishul concluded its port call at Civitavecchia, Italy, during its Mediterranean deployment.
content: INS Trishul concluded its port call at Civitavecchia, Italy, during its Mediterranean deployment. Its Commanding Officer called on the Italian Navy’s Fleet Commander, and the crew visited the aircraft carrier ITS Cavour.

headline: The Indian Navy deployed five Defence Fire Tenders from INS Gomantak, INS Hansa and the Naval Armament Depot to help Goa...
content: The Indian Navy deployed five Defence Fire Tenders from INS Gomantak, INS Hansa and the Naval Armament Depot to help Goa Fire Services contain a major fire at Vasco Market, Vasco da Gama, on 28 October.

headline: India has issued a navigational warning for likely missile testing in the Bay of Bengal between 29 October and 6 November,...
content: India has issued a navigational warning for likely missile testing in the Bay of Bengal between 29 October and 6 November, with a danger zone suggesting a range of about 590 km, Indian Defence News reported, citing an open-source analyst. The system to be tested has not been named.

headline: DRDO said the wheeled variant of the Vikram VT-21 infantry combat vehicle has met key requirements in development trials,...
content: DRDO said the wheeled variant of the Vikram VT-21 infantry combat vehicle has met key requirements in development trials, including mobility, trench crossing and amphibious performance with the turret fitted. It is being developed by VRDE, Ahilyanagar, with Tata Advanced Systems and Bharat Forge.

headline: India and Armenia held Foreign Office Consultations co-chaired by MEA Secretary (West) Sibi George and Armenia’s Deputy...
content: India and Armenia held Foreign Office Consultations co-chaired by MEA Secretary (West) Sibi George and Armenia’s Deputy Foreign Minister Mnatsakan Safaryan, reviewing trade and investment, science and technology, AI, education, culture and people-to-people ties.

headline: India voted in favour of a UN General Assembly resolution calling for an end to the US economic, commercial and financial...
content: India voted in favour of a UN General Assembly resolution calling for an end to the US economic, commercial and financial embargo on Cuba, adopted with 130 votes in favour, 17 against and 25 abstentions. Counsellor Soumya Nair delivered India’s statement.

headline: At the UN Security Council’s open debate on Women, Peace and Security, India’s Permanent Representative P. Harish said about...
content: At the UN Security Council’s open debate on Women, Peace and Security, India’s Permanent Representative P. Harish said about 750 million women and girls live within 50 km of conflict zones and conflict-related sexual violence has more than doubled. He cited Indian peacekeepers Majors Mouiz Yaseen and Sonia Devendra Nevaskar.

headline: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said the proposed India-US trade deal will protect farmers’ interests.
content: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said the proposed India-US trade deal will protect farmers’ interests. He said India has signed nine trade agreements covering 38 developed nations with a combined GDP of $60 trillion.

headline: British PM Andy Burnham is keen to visit India and a trip could take place soon, Acting British High Commissioner Ben Mellor said.
content: British PM Andy Burnham is keen to visit India and a trip could take place soon, Acting British High Commissioner Ben Mellor said. He said new deals worth £12 billion have followed the India-UK FTA, which came into force 100 days ago, and the two nations aim to double trade to about $120 billion by 2030.

headline: Rafel Jordà Siquier, Founder and CEO of European space company Open Cosmos, met PM Narendra Modi and Finance Minister...
content: Rafel Jordà Siquier, Founder and CEO of European space company Open Cosmos, met PM Narendra Modi and Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman alongside a Liechtenstein delegation, and signalled the company’s interest in investing in India.

headline: A 14-member Singapore Business Federation delegation met UP CM Yogi Adityanath in Lucknow and showed interest in investing...
content: A 14-member Singapore Business Federation delegation met UP CM Yogi Adityanath in Lucknow and showed interest in investing in logistics, semiconductors, data centres and green energy. The CM proposed a dedicated ‘Singapore City’ near Noida International Airport at Jewar.

headline: Iran declared the Strait of Hormuz closed to “violating ships” after its navy said a tanker hit a naval mine and caught fire...
content: Iran declared the Strait of Hormuz closed to “violating ships” after its navy said a tanker hit a naval mine and caught fire east of the strait; the IRGC claimed three more tankers struck mines, which has not been independently confirmed. UKMTO reported a dhow that caught fire and sank 9 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman; its crew was rescued.

headline: The death toll from a Russian drone strike on a commuter train in Dnipro, Ukraine, rose to 14, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.
content: The death toll from a Russian drone strike on a commuter train in Dnipro, Ukraine, rose to 14, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said. Strikes on Chernihiv and Kremenchuk killed five more, and 56 people, including 10 children, were injured.

headline: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde will step down on 7 February, nine months before her eight-year term ends...
content: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde will step down on 7 February, nine months before her eight-year term ends on 31 October 2027; European Council President António Costa said the selection of her successor begins now.

headline: Israel’s Central Elections Committee completed the vote count
content: Israel’s Central Elections Committee completed the vote count: PM Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc won 53 of the 120 Knesset seats, short of the 61 needed for a majority, Gadi Eisenkot’s opposition bloc 48 and Arab-led parties 19. Likud is the largest party with 27 seats; official results are due next Wednesday.

headline: The US economy grew at an annualised 3.
content: The US economy grew at an annualised 3.4% in July–September 2026, up from 2.2% in the previous quarter, according to the Bureau of Economic Analysis’s advance estimate.

headline: Manisha Bhanwala stormed into the women’s 59 kg final at the World Wrestling Championships in Astana, beating home favourite...
content: Manisha Bhanwala stormed into the women’s 59 kg final at the World Wrestling Championships in Astana, beating home favourite Altyn Shagayeva 10-0 by fall in the semifinal. She faces Pan American champion Abigail Nette of the USA for gold today, as Sujeet Kalkal lost in the quarterfinals.

headline: India beat China 5-2 at the Men’s Asian Champions Trophy hockey in Jalandhar for their second straight win, with captain...
content: India beat China 5-2 at the Men’s Asian Champions Trophy hockey in Jalandhar for their second straight win, with captain Harmanpreet Singh converting two penalty corners and Sukhjeet Singh scoring two field goals; Jugraj Singh added one. India play Japan today.

headline: P.
content: P.V. Sindhu beat France’s Pancasari 21-9, 21-6 and Lakshya Sen beat compatriot Kiran George 21-15, 18-21, 21-12 to reach the singles quarterfinals of the Hylo Open Super 500 in Saarbrücken, Germany. Sindhu faces Denmark’s Amalie Schulz next; Malvika Bansod and Isharani Baruah exited.

headline: India, who have clinched the five-match T20I series against New Zealand with a 3-0 lead, play the fourth T20I at Eden Park,...
content: India, who have clinched the five-match T20I series against New Zealand with a 3-0 lead, play the fourth T20I at Eden Park, Auckland, today from 12:30 PM IST. The final match is on Sunday.

headline: Afghanistan leg-spinner Rashid Khan became the first bowler to take 200 wickets in men’s T20Is, dismissing Zimbabwe’s...
content: Afghanistan leg-spinner Rashid Khan became the first bowler to take 200 wickets in men’s T20Is, dismissing Zimbabwe’s Tadiwanashe Marumani in the second T20I at Sharjah, where Azmatullah Omarzai smashed 116 off 50 balls.

headline: Elena Rybakina secured the year-end WTA No. 1 ranking by beating Yulia Putintseva 6-2, 6-3 at the Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo.
content: Elena Rybakina secured the year-end WTA No. 1 ranking by beating Yulia Putintseva 6-2, 6-3 at the Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo. She first became world No. 1 last month after winning the US Open.

headline: PM Shri Narendra Modi will inaugurate the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo (BRESE) 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi,...
content: PM Shri Narendra Modi will inaugurate the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo (BRESE) 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on 2 November. The 2–5 November summit expects over 130 countries; India has 308 GW of installed non-fossil fuel capacity and is on course for its 500 GW target by 2030, the MNRE said.

headline: The Union Cabinet approved a ₹10,000 crore Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme up to FY 2039-40, with interest...
content: The Union Cabinet approved a ₹10,000 crore Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme up to FY 2039-40, with interest subvention support of ₹859 crore, output-linked assistance of ₹8,891 crore and ₹150 crore for testing. It aims to raise domestic capacity about tenfold to 7.5 lakh TEUs, creating some 3,000 direct and over 50,000 indirect jobs.

headline: The Cabinet also cleared the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme with an outlay of ₹1,856.
content: The Cabinet also cleared the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme with an outlay of ₹1,856.67 crore from 2026 to 2033-34. It will set up Sports Goods Manufacturing Zones and give Anchor Investment Support and Turnover Linked Support, in line with the Khelo Bharat Niti 2025.

headline: The Cabinet approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana, a centrally sponsored scheme for 2026-27 to 2030-31 with...
content: The Cabinet approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana, a centrally sponsored scheme for 2026-27 to 2030-31 with an outlay of ₹7,395.55 crore (Centre ₹4,869.48 crore, States ₹2,526.07 crore). It will strengthen Panchayats and train about 32 lakh elected representatives, with Gram Panchayat Development Plans prepared on eGramSwaraj.

headline: Central government employees and pensioners will get an additional 3% Dearness Allowance and Dearness Relief from 1 July...
content: Central government employees and pensioners will get an additional 3% Dearness Allowance and Dearness Relief from 1 July 2026, over the existing 60%, after Cabinet approval. The hike will cost ₹10,016.10 crore a year and benefit 48.54 lakh employees and 68.71 lakh pensioners.

headline: MSME Minister Jitan Ram Manjhi released ₹1,000 crore of margin money subsidy under the Prime Minister’s Employment...
content: MSME Minister Jitan Ram Manjhi released ₹1,000 crore of margin money subsidy under the Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) for 11,333 new micro enterprises. The support unlocks bank credit of ₹3,260 crore and is expected to create over 1.02 lakh jobs.

headline: The Textiles Ministry will reopen the PLI Scheme for Textiles portal for Round 4 applications from 1 November to 31 December...
content: The Textiles Ministry will reopen the PLI Scheme for Textiles portal for Round 4 applications from 1 November to 31 December 2026 for MMF apparel, MMF fabrics and technical textiles. The minimum turnover for Part 2 has been cut from ₹200 crore to ₹100 crore, and the tenure extended to 2033-34 for Round 4 applicants.

headline: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has revised the MRPs of 543 brands of anti-cancer medicines, with cuts...
content: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has revised the MRPs of 543 brands of anti-cancer medicines, with cuts of over 90% in some cases, effective 9 November. Anastrozole tablets (Anarzole, 10 tablets) will now cost ₹73 instead of ₹695.76, and the denosumab injection Debrumab ₹5,941 instead of ₹22,031.25.

headline: MoS Health Prataprao Jadhav launched the 60-day Tobacco-Free Youth Campaign 4.
content: MoS Health Prataprao Jadhav launched the 60-day Tobacco-Free Youth Campaign 4.0 at ABVIMS–Dr RML Hospital, New Delhi, with special focus on tobacco-free college and university campuses. Over 5.8 lakh educational institutions and 73,000 villages were declared tobacco-free in the first three editions.

headline: The Jal Shakti Ministry launched the ‘Punah Bharan’ mobile app, developed by BISAG-N with the National Water Mission, to...
content: The Jal Shakti Ministry launched the ‘Punah Bharan’ mobile app, developed by BISAG-N with the National Water Mission, to plan scientific groundwater recharge. It identifies possible artificial recharge zones within 3 km of the user, and its web portal gives village-level recharge zonation maps.

headline: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) has cut its transaction charge to 0.
content: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) has cut its transaction charge to 0.30%, raised the exemption threshold to ₹10 lakh and reduced OEM assessment fees by up to 92%, easing costs for sellers, especially small businesses.

headline: Cyclone ‘Arnab’ crossed the Andhra Pradesh–Yanam coast southwest of Yanam between 2 am and 8 am on Wednesday with winds of...
content: Cyclone ‘Arnab’ crossed the Andhra Pradesh–Yanam coast southwest of Yanam between 2 am and 8 am on Wednesday with winds of 125–135 kmph gusting to 150 kmph, then weakened over land. CM N. Chandrababu Naidu asked Union Home Minister Amit Shah for a central team to assess the damage; crops over 2.24 lakh hectares in 14 districts were damaged, affecting 3.45 lakh farmers, and 16 NDRF and 11 SDRF teams were deployed.

headline: In Odisha, IMD issued a red warning for Ganjam, Gajapati, Rayagada, Koraput, Malkangiri and Nabarangpur districts for...
content: In Odisha, IMD issued a red warning for Ganjam, Gajapati, Rayagada, Koraput, Malkangiri and Nabarangpur districts for isolated extremely heavy rain, as Arnab’s remnants moved north. A station in Gajapati recorded 249.9 mm of rain.

headline: ISRO will launch the navigation satellite NVS-03 on GSLV-F18 from the Second Launch Pad at Sriharikota at 11:51 PM on 30 October.
content: ISRO will launch the navigation satellite NVS-03 on GSLV-F18 from the Second Launch Pad at Sriharikota at 11:51 PM on 30 October. The 2,250 kg satellite, with an indigenous atomic clock, will help NavIC regain the minimum number of satellites needed for standalone regional navigation services.

headline: In the Legislative Council polls for 28 seats in four States, Congress lost all four seats in Karnataka (BJP three, JD(S)...
content: In the Legislative Council polls for 28 seats in four States, Congress lost all four seats in Karnataka (BJP three, JD(S) one), the BJP won six of 11 seats in Uttar Pradesh but lost the Varanasi teachers’ seat to the SP, and the Jan Suraaj Party opened its account in Bihar. In Maharashtra, NCP (SP) won two seats and the BJP and Shiv Sena one each, while Congress’s Abhijit Wanjari claimed victory in Nagpur Graduates after BJP’s Sudhakar Kohale reportedly conceded.

headline: The NHRC issued an advisory on the ‘Protection of Human Rights of Female Inmates and their Children’ to nine Union...
content: The NHRC issued an advisory on the ‘Protection of Human Rights of Female Inmates and their Children’ to nine Union Ministries and all States and UTs, covering ten key areas including maternal and child healthcare and access to justice, and sought progress reports within two months.

headline: The Railway Board has told all zones to strictly switch off mobile and laptop charging points in coaches between 11 pm and 5...
content: The Railway Board has told all zones to strictly switch off mobile and laptop charging points in coaches between 11 pm and 5 am for fire safety, reiterating its 2014 order after a passenger’s power bank exploded on a train in South Eastern Railway.

headline: Union Home Minister Amit Shah will inaugurate the Shaheed Smarak in Ambala Cantonment, Haryana, on 5 November, Minister Anil Vij said.
content: Union Home Minister Amit Shah will inaugurate the Shaheed Smarak in Ambala Cantonment, Haryana, on 5 November, Minister Anil Vij said. Built at a cost of about ₹800 crore, the memorial displays the history of the 1857 First War of Independence and will open to the public on 6 November.

headline: Bangladesh’s Foreign Secretary Asad Alam Siam will take charge as the country’s High Commissioner to India in New Delhi in...
content: Bangladesh’s Foreign Secretary Asad Alam Siam will take charge as the country’s High Commissioner to India in New Delhi in November, succeeding Riaz Hamidullah, who has moved to Geneva. A career diplomat, Siam has earlier served as Bangladesh’s Ambassador to the US and as Chief of Protocol.

headline: In a reshuffle of 12 IAS officers, Telangana posted Special Chief Secretary Jayesh Ranjan to the Environment, Forests,...
content: In a reshuffle of 12 IAS officers, Telangana posted Special Chief Secretary Jayesh Ranjan to the Environment, Forests, Science and Technology Department with full additional charge as DG of EPTRI, a day after he announced he would seek voluntary retirement. Vikas Raj moves to Energy, and Navin Mittal to Panchayat Raj and Rural Development.

headline: The Tamil Nadu government reshuffled IAS officers on Wednesday
content: The Tamil Nadu government reshuffled IAS officers on Wednesday: S. Shanthi has been posted as CEO of the Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority (CMDA), Monica Rana, Commissioner of Tirunelveli Corporation, as Collector of Tenkasi, and C. Muthukumar, Collector of Karur, as Collector of Tiruppur.

headline: The Supreme Court questioned the Election Commission for asking people deleted from Delhi’s draft rolls in the SIR to apply...
content: The Supreme Court questioned the Election Commission for asking people deleted from Delhi’s draft rolls in the SIR to apply afresh through Form 6, which is meant for first-time voters, and suggested Form 8 for those who shifted. The Bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana said the right to vote is a “vital right” and asked the EC to consider extending the 30 October deadline if needed.

headline: Calling fake “digital arrest” cyber frauds “digital dacoity”, the Supreme Court refused to consolidate 35 criminal cases...
content: Calling fake “digital arrest” cyber frauds “digital dacoity”, the Supreme Court refused to consolidate 35 criminal cases across 12 States against two persons, Gourab Kumar Saha and Nidhi Bhandari, accused of letting their firm’s bank account be used as a mule account. The CJI noted that an 81-year-old Ernakulam resident had lost ₹1.90 crore.

headline: Kolkata Police arrested former West Bengal minister and singer Indranil Sen over alleged financial irregularities in Durga...
content: Kolkata Police arrested former West Bengal minister and singer Indranil Sen over alleged financial irregularities in Durga Puja ‘preview shows’ and the sale of passes by MassArt Society, after hours of questioning by the ED and the police.

headline: The Enforcement Directorate provisionally attached the land and 59 buildings of Mohammad Ali Jauhar University in Rampur,...
content: The Enforcement Directorate provisionally attached the land and 59 buildings of Mohammad Ali Jauhar University in Rampur, run by a trust controlled by jailed SP leader Azam Khan, in a money laundering case. The ED says ₹426.46 crore of the campus cost is proceeds of crime; the property’s market value is about ₹1,170 crore.

headline: A 19-month-old cheetah, KNG22, from Kuno National Park died on 27 October after being shot five times with a pellet gun...
content: A 19-month-old cheetah, KNG22, from Kuno National Park died on 27 October after being shot five times with a pellet gun outside the park in Morena — the first gunshot death since the cheetahs were brought to India in 2022. The Centre has sent a team of NTCA and Wildlife Crime Control Bureau officials, and Madhya Pradesh has formed a special task force.

headline: Lawyers allegedly vandalised the courtroom of Allahabad High Court judge Justice Ajay Bhanot amid protests over his conduct,...
content: Lawyers allegedly vandalised the courtroom of Allahabad High Court judge Justice Ajay Bhanot amid protests over his conduct, a day after the High Court Bar Association wrote to Chief Justice Arun Bhansali alleging that the judge had humiliated an advocate and mocked a senior advocate.

headline: The Supreme Court set aside the Indian Navy Selection Board’s April 2024 decision denying Permanent Commission to JAG Branch...
content: The Supreme Court set aside the Indian Navy Selection Board’s April 2024 decision denying Permanent Commission to JAG Branch woman officer Seema Chaudhary and ordered it to reconsider her claim within six weeks. The Bench led by CJI Surya Kant said past non-recommendations cannot overshadow her favourable Annual Confidential Reports.

headline: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh met US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth on the sidelines of the ADMM-Plus in Cebu, Philippines,...
content: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh met US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth on the sidelines of the ADMM-Plus in Cebu, Philippines, and reviewed the 10-year India-US Defence Framework, focusing on military technology, information sharing and co-production. He also objected to the $686 million US-aided sustainment package for Pakistan’s F-16 fleet, sources said.

headline: Rajnath Singh and Japan’s Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi reviewed progress in maritime security cooperation, including...
content: Rajnath Singh and Japan’s Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi reviewed progress in maritime security cooperation, including mine countermeasure capabilities and possible joint development in naval shipbuilding and design, and said their shared commitment is vital for a free, open and peaceful Indo-Pacific.

headline: Rajnath Singh met Australia’s Deputy PM and Defence Minister Richard Marles and discussed bilateral defence cooperation,...
content: Rajnath Singh met Australia’s Deputy PM and Defence Minister Richard Marles and discussed bilateral defence cooperation, military interoperability and regional security challenges, completing meetings with all three of India’s Quad partners.

headline: Rajnath Singh held talks with South Korea’s Minister of National Defense Kang Shin-chul on ways to co-develop military...
content: Rajnath Singh held talks with South Korea’s Minister of National Defense Kang Shin-chul on ways to co-develop military technologies, enhance joint industry collaboration and promote maritime security in the Indo-Pacific.

headline: In talks with Singapore’s Defence Minister Chan Chun Sing, Rajnath Singh discussed expanding joint exercises across the...
content: In talks with Singapore’s Defence Minister Chan Chun Sing, Rajnath Singh discussed expanding joint exercises across the Army, Navy and Air Force, and called Singapore a key pillar of India’s Act East Policy.

headline: Indigenous stealth frigate INS Sahyadri arrived at Busan Naval Harbour, South Korea, for the India-Republic of Korea Navy...
content: Indigenous stealth frigate INS Sahyadri arrived at Busan Naval Harbour, South Korea, for the India-Republic of Korea Navy bilateral exercise. The harbour phase will be followed by coordinated activities at sea with ROKS Munmu the Great.

headline: The 10th annual coordination meeting between India’s Sashastra Seema Bal and Nepal’s Armed Police Force began in Kathmandu,...
content: The 10th annual coordination meeting between India’s Sashastra Seema Bal and Nepal’s Armed Police Force began in Kathmandu, led by SSB DG Sanjay Singhal and APF IG Narayan Dutta Paudel. The three-day talks cover human trafficking, drug and arms smuggling and intelligence-sharing along the open border.

headline: Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan met a delegation of the European Parliament’s Committee on Foreign Affairs (AFET) led by...
content: Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan met a delegation of the European Parliament’s Committee on Foreign Affairs (AFET) led by David McAllister at Parliament House. He said India and the EU, as the two largest democracies and open market economies, share an interest in shaping a resilient multipolar world order.

headline: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar held talks with Austrian Foreign Minister Beate Meinl-Reisinger in New Delhi on...
content: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar held talks with Austrian Foreign Minister Beate Meinl-Reisinger in New Delhi on trade, investment, startups, space, skilling and mobility. He said India looks forward to the India-EU FTA entering into force in the coming months.

headline: The MEA said Jaishankar will attend the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in Atlanta, US, on 30–31 October and a Quad Foreign...
content: The MEA said Jaishankar will attend the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in Atlanta, US, on 30–31 October and a Quad Foreign Ministers’ Meeting on the sidelines, then lead India’s delegation to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) in St John’s, Antigua and Barbuda, from 1 to 4 November.

headline: India and Mexico signed the Terms of Reference for a Preferential Trade Agreement, formally launching negotiations.
content: India and Mexico signed the Terms of Reference for a Preferential Trade Agreement, formally launching negotiations. They were signed in Mexico by Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal and Mexico’s Undersecretary of Foreign Trade Luis Rosendo Gutiérrez Romano.

headline: The MEA said 22 Indians, including 14 seafarers, have been killed in the ongoing West Asia conflict, three of them in Saudi Arabia.
content: The MEA said 22 Indians, including 14 seafarers, have been killed in the ongoing West Asia conflict, three of them in Saudi Arabia. India voiced serious concern over Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and the threat to shipping through the Bab-el-Mandeb strait.

headline: Ports Minister Sarbananda Sonowal met HD Hyundai Chairman Chung Ki-sun in Seoul on the proposed greenfield mega shipyard at...
content: Ports Minister Sarbananda Sonowal met HD Hyundai Chairman Chung Ki-sun in Seoul on the proposed greenfield mega shipyard at Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu. A Joint Working Group will steer the project, with the joint venture structure and DPR expected within six months.

headline: At CBD COP17 in Yerevan, Armenia, Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav released four Indian publications on biodiversity...
content: At CBD COP17 in Yerevan, Armenia, Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav released four Indian publications on biodiversity conservation, biosafety and access and benefit sharing, and called for turning global biodiversity commitments into implementation, sustainable finance and cooperation.

headline: At least 68 people were killed when a Renfe AVE high-speed train collided with an Iryo train near Urda in Spain’s Toledo...
content: At least 68 people were killed when a Renfe AVE high-speed train collided with an Iryo train near Urda in Spain’s Toledo province on the Madrid–Seville line. PM Pedro Sánchez ordered an investigation, promising a strong response if negligence is found, and declared three days of national mourning from 29 to 31 October.

headline: Israel’s election produced no clear majority
content: Israel’s election produced no clear majority: with about 85.6% of votes counted, PM Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc had 53 seats and Gadi Eisenkot’s opposition bloc 48, with Arab-led parties projected to win 19; 61 seats are needed in the 120-member Knesset. Likud alleged fraud at Arab polling stations.

headline: More than 100 people were killed and 113 injured in a drone strike on a busy market in Nyala, capital of Sudan’s South...
content: More than 100 people were killed and 113 injured in a drone strike on a busy market in Nyala, capital of Sudan’s South Darfur, said the rights group Emergency Lawyers, which blamed the Sudanese army. Nyala is held by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces.

headline: The US Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.
content: The US Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.75–4% in a 10-2 vote, with two members favouring a 25-basis-point hike, citing persistently elevated inflation.

headline: The World Bank said global commodity prices are projected to rise 23% in 2026, with energy prices up 32%, as the Middle East...
content: The World Bank said global commodity prices are projected to rise 23% in 2026, with energy prices up 32%, as the Middle East conflict disrupts oil and grain shipments. Brent crude is forecast to average $91 a barrel in 2026, up from $69 in 2025.

headline: Kajal Dhochak (76 kg) and Neelam Sirohi (50 kg) won silver medals at the World Wrestling Championships in Astana
content: Kajal Dhochak (76 kg) and Neelam Sirohi (50 kg) won silver medals at the World Wrestling Championships in Astana — the first time two Indian women reached the finals at the same edition. Kajal, 18, lost 6-8 to Ukraine’s Anastasiya Alpyeyeva, while Neelam lost by fall to Japan’s four-time world champion Yui Susaki.

headline: India women beat Zimbabwe by eight wickets in the third ODI at Vadodara to sweep the series 3-0, after also winning the T20Is 3-0.
content: India women beat Zimbabwe by eight wickets in the third ODI at Vadodara to sweep the series 3-0, after also winning the T20Is 3-0. Left-arm spinner Vaishnavi Sharma took five wickets as Zimbabwe were bowled out for 131 in 39.5 overs, and Pratika Rawal and Shafali Verma hit unbeaten half-centuries.

headline: At the WPL 2027 auction in Kochi, UP Warriorz signed Australia captain Sophie Molineux for...
content: At the WPL 2027 auction in Kochi, UP Warriorz signed Australia captain Sophie Molineux for ₹1.10 crore, the costliest buy. Kiran Navgire was the highest-paid Indian, joining Delhi Capitals for ₹75 lakh, while G. Kamalini went to Gujarat Giants for ₹40 lakh.

headline: Abhishek Sharma replaced Ishan Kishan at No. 1 in the ICC men’s T20I batting rankings after his 113 off 38 balls against New Zealand.
content: Abhishek Sharma replaced Ishan Kishan at No. 1 in the ICC men’s T20I batting rankings after his 113 off 38 balls against New Zealand. South Africa’s Marco Jansen replaced Ravindra Jadeja as the No. 1 Test all-rounder.

headline: Three-time Grand Slam champion Stan Wawrinka, 41, retired after a 7-5, 7-6 (7/2) first-round loss to Jiri Lehecka at the Basel Open.
content: Three-time Grand Slam champion Stan Wawrinka, 41, retired after a 7-5, 7-6 (7/2) first-round loss to Jiri Lehecka at the Basel Open. The Swiss won the 2014 Australian Open, 2015 French Open and 2016 US Open, and Olympic doubles gold with Roger Federer in 2008.

headline: The Sports and Education Ministries signed an MoU with UNESCO to take clean sport values to classrooms through the ‘Sports...
content: The Sports and Education Ministries signed an MoU with UNESCO to take clean sport values to classrooms through the ‘Sports Values in Every Classroom Toolkit’, with video modules in 13 Indian languages, at NADA India’s Clean Sport Conclave.

headline: President Smt Droupadi Murmu has promulgated the Lakshadweep Tourism Trade (Registration, Safety and Facilitation)...
content: President Smt Droupadi Murmu has promulgated the Lakshadweep Tourism Trade (Registration, Safety and Facilitation) Regulation, 2026, making registration compulsory for lodging, water sports, tour guides, travel agents, digital booking platforms and tourism vessels in the UT, with strict safety norms and heavy penalties for damage to fragile marine ecosystems. Existing operators get six months to register; applications must be decided within 45 to 60 days, failing which they will be deemed accepted.

headline: The Zoological Survey of India has described a new deep-sea electric ray, Tetronarce ramanamurthyi, named the Arabian Black...
content: The Zoological Survey of India has described a new deep-sea electric ray, Tetronarce ramanamurthyi, named the Arabian Black Electric Ray, from the southeastern Arabian Sea — the first confirmed record of the genus in the northern Indian Ocean. The work, under the Deep Ocean Mission, is published in the journal Zootaxa.

headline: TRAI data show India had 1,367.
content: TRAI data show India had 1,367.93 million telephone subscribers at the end of September 2026, with overall tele-density at 95.52%. Broadband subscribers, including M2M cellular connections, stood at 1,107.68 million, and 16.77 million mobile number portability requests were received during the month.

headline: Under the Gyan Bharatam Mission, the Culture Ministry signed an MoU with the Bibliothèque nationale de France in Paris for...
content: Under the Gyan Bharatam Mission, the Culture Ministry signed an MoU with the Bibliothèque nationale de France in Paris for digitisation, digital access, technology exchange, conservation and research on Indic-origin manuscripts. It was signed by Culture Secretary Vivek Aggarwal and BnF President Gilles Pécout.

headline: Over 99.
content: Over 99.32 lakh names have been removed from Karnataka’s electoral rolls in the Special Intensive Revision, bringing the electorate down from 5.54 crore to 4.55 crore in the final roll. It has about 2.25 crore men, 2.29 crore women and 2,841 third-gender voters, including 6.83 lakh aged 18–19.

headline: Telangana has officially declared drought in 365 of its 621 mandals (58.7%) across 31 districts
content: Telangana has officially declared drought in 365 of its 621 mandals (58.7%) across 31 districts — 111 severe and 254 moderate — for the kharif season; only Hyderabad and Peddapalli districts were spared.

headline: Punjab and Haryana Bar Council elects 23-year-old lawyer Asmi unopposed, youngest ever State Bar Council member.
content: Punjab and Haryana Bar Council elects 23-year-old lawyer Asmi unopposed, youngest ever State Bar Council member.  She has created history by becoming the youngest-ever member of a State Bar Council in the country and the first member from Generation Z to be elected to any State Bar Council.

headline: Vande Bharat Sleeper train
content: Vande Bharat Sleeper train: Two new Vande Bharat sleeper trains will connect major cities in India and enhance overnight travel options. The Mumbai-Bengaluru service is set to launch on November 1, while the Delhi-Varanasi service is likely to start on October 31. Both services aim to significantly reduce travel times compared to existing options. Passengers should check the final schedules and train numbers before making travel plans.

headline: A network outage of more than an hour at Mumbai’s Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport on Tuesday evening...
content: A network outage of more than an hour at Mumbai’s Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport on Tuesday evening delayed 327 flights, forcing staff to switch to manual check-in. Operator MIAL said essential services continued.

headline: Sashastra Seema Bal Director General Sanjay Singhal, a 1993-batch UP-cadre IPS officer, has been given additional charge of...
content: Sashastra Seema Bal Director General Sanjay Singhal, a 1993-batch UP-cadre IPS officer, has been given additional charge of DG, Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) from 31 October, when incumbent Shatrujeet Singh Kapoor retires, until a regular appointment is made. Singhal has headed the SSB since 1 September 2025 and earlier served in the ITBP as DIG and IG (2008–2015).

headline: Jammu and Kashmir LG Manoj Sinha administered the oath to four National Conference MLAs
content: Jammu and Kashmir LG Manoj Sinha administered the oath to four National Conference MLAs — Ali Mohammad Sagar (Khanyar), Shameema Firdous (Habba Kadal), Mir Saifullah (Trehgam) and Altaf Ahmad Wani alias Kaloo (Pahalgam) — at Lok Bhavan, Srinagar, in CM Omar Abdullah’s first Cabinet expansion. The Cabinet now has its maximum strength of nine; Independent MLA Satish Sharma was dropped.

headline: Anup Bagchi took charge as Managing Director and CEO of HDFC Bank, India’s largest private sector lender, on 27 October,...
content: Anup Bagchi took charge as Managing Director and CEO of HDFC Bank, India’s largest private sector lender, on 27 October, succeeding Sashidhar Jagdishan, whose term ended on 26 October. An ICICI Group veteran who last headed ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, he is the first outsider to lead the bank in its over three-decade history.

headline: The Supreme Court gave petitioners 10 days to file rejoinders to the Election Commission’s affidavit defending the Special...
content: The Supreme Court gave petitioners 10 days to file rejoinders to the Election Commission’s affidavit defending the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The Bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana also asked the EC to respond to TMC MP Dola Sen’s plea alleging changes to Form 6 in Bihar without the court’s approval.

headline: The Supreme Court issued notice to Lok Sabha LoP Rahul Gandhi and others on a plea alleging that he pushed a pregnant...
content: The Supreme Court issued notice to Lok Sabha LoP Rahul Gandhi and others on a plea alleging that he pushed a pregnant journalist during the 12 October march to the apex court. The plea was mentioned before a Bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi.

headline: The Supreme Court held that there is no bar under the UAPA on granting bail to a foreign national if the accused’s initial...
content: The Supreme Court held that there is no bar under the UAPA on granting bail to a foreign national if the accused’s initial entry into India was legal. A Bench of Justices Aravind Kumar and Vipul M. Pancholi upheld a Madras High Court order restoring bail to Sri Lankan national Mohmad Rifas, noting that the NIA had shown no material that his entry was illegal.

headline: Hearing the Digital News Publishers Association’s challenge to the Digital Personal Data Protection Act and Rules, the...
content: Hearing the Digital News Publishers Association’s challenge to the Digital Personal Data Protection Act and Rules, the Supreme Court issued notice to the Law and IT Ministries but refused an interim stay, saying a balance must be struck between press freedom and individual rights. DNPA argued newsrooms would shut if journalists needed prior consent; the case will be heard on 17 November.

headline: A Supreme Court Bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta slammed the Rajasthan government over illegal mining and...
content: A Supreme Court Bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta slammed the Rajasthan government over illegal mining and pollution in the Jojari-Bandi-Luni river system and said it may order a CBI investigation. “Making 20 lakh people live in hell can’t be compared with your economic viability,” the Bench said, listing the case for 27 November.

headline: Mumbai Police have invoked the stringent Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA) in the 18 October firing on...
content: Mumbai Police have invoked the stringent Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA) in the 18 October firing on actor Tiger Shroff’s car in Juhu. The Crime Branch has arrested 11 people allegedly linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang; Anil Pandit has been named as a wanted accused.

headline: Thirteen of the 17 undertrial prisoners who overpowered guards and escaped from the Thekkampatti sub-jail near Andipatti in...
content: Thirteen of the 17 undertrial prisoners who overpowered guards and escaped from the Thekkampatti sub-jail near Andipatti in Tamil Nadu’s Theni district on Monday night have been recaptured, and nine prison staff have been suspended. DMK chief M.K. Stalin attacked the TVK government over the jailbreak.

headline: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh arrived in Cebu, Philippines, for the 13th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus),...
content: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh arrived in Cebu, Philippines, for the 13th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus (ADMM-Plus), where he will hold bilateral meetings, reiterating India’s commitment to ASEAN centrality. Earlier, he saluted the Army’s infantrymen on Shaurya Diwas (Infantry Day).

headline: The 11th edition of the India-Indonesia Joint Special Forces Exercise GARUDA SHAKTI began at Banyuwangi, Indonesia, and will...
content: The 11th edition of the India-Indonesia Joint Special Forces Exercise GARUDA SHAKTI began at Banyuwangi, Indonesia, and will run till 6 November. Troops of the Parachute Regiment (Special Forces) are training with Indonesian Special Forces in jungle operations, air assault, mountaineering and combat marksmanship.

headline: Yard 1283 ‘Srishti’, a Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessel (NGOPV) for the Navy, was launched at Goa Shipyard Limited in...
content: Yard 1283 ‘Srishti’, a Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessel (NGOPV) for the Navy, was launched at Goa Shipyard Limited in the presence of Vishvajit Sahay, Secretary (Defence Finance). NGOPVs are being built at GSL and GRSE for surveillance, search and rescue, offshore-asset protection, HADR and anti-piracy tasks.

headline: The 33rd Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise (SIMBEX-2026), hosted by the Navy at Visakhapatnam, concluded on 26 October.
content: The 33rd Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise (SIMBEX-2026), hosted by the Navy at Visakhapatnam, concluded on 26 October. INS Nilgiri, INS Kamorta, P-8I and Dornier aircraft and MH-60R helicopters exercised with Singapore’s stealth frigate RSS Supreme in anti-submarine, anti-air and anti-surface drills in the Bay of Bengal.

headline: The Navy’s First Training Squadron
content: The Navy’s First Training Squadron — INS Tir, INS Sujata and ICGS Sarathi — arrived at Colombo, Sri Lanka, for a port call that includes cross-training visits and a Passage Exercise (PASSEX) with the Sri Lanka Navy.

headline: Bengaluru-based AI start-up Sarvam has signed an umbrella MoU with Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff (HQ IDS) under the...
content: Bengaluru-based AI start-up Sarvam has signed an umbrella MoU with Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff (HQ IDS) under the Defence Ministry for artificial intelligence projects across the Army, Navy, Air Force and tri-service organisations. The value of the pact has not been disclosed.

headline: The first 300-tonne Sullage Barge (Yard 142) for the Navy was launched, and keels were laid for Yards 144 and 148, at MSME...
content: The first 300-tonne Sullage Barge (Yard 142) for the Navy was launched, and keels were laid for Yards 144 and 148, at MSME shipyard Suryadipta Projects, Thane. The indigenously designed barges will help naval platforms comply with MARPOL pollution rules.

headline: President Droupadi Murmu received Hereditary Prince Alois and Hereditary Princess Sophie of Liechtenstein at Rashtrapati...
content: President Droupadi Murmu received Hereditary Prince Alois and Hereditary Princess Sophie of Liechtenstein at Rashtrapati Bhavan and hosted a banquet in their honour. She said the India-EFTA TEPA commitment to facilitate $100 billion of investment and 1 million direct jobs in India over 15 years gives a robust foundation for cooperation.

headline: PM Narendra Modi met Hereditary Prince Alois of Liechtenstein; the two leaders reviewed progress under the India-EFTA Trade...
content: PM Narendra Modi met Hereditary Prince Alois of Liechtenstein; the two leaders reviewed progress under the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA), which has completed its first year, and discussed ways to boost investment and economic cooperation.

headline: Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan met a Russian parliamentary delegation led by State Duma Chairman Vyacheslav Volodin in...
content: Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan met a Russian parliamentary delegation led by State Duma Chairman Vyacheslav Volodin in New Delhi and expressed confidence that India and Russia will reach their target of $100 billion in annual trade by 2030. He also hosted a luncheon for BRICS presiding officers at Parliament.

headline: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum concluded in New Delhi with a unanimously adopted Joint Declaration voicing deep concern...
content: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum concluded in New Delhi with a unanimously adopted Joint Declaration voicing deep concern over the escalation in West Asia, urging protection of civilians and civilian infrastructure, condemning unilateral coercive measures and backing reform of the UN, including the Security Council.

headline: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said in The Hague that India’s FTA talks with Chile are nearing conclusion and negotiations...
content: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said in The Hague that India’s FTA talks with Chile are nearing conclusion and negotiations with the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) have begun. India-China trade rose about 29% to $91.76 billion in April–September, making China India’s largest trading partner in the first half of 2026-27.

headline: Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav reached Yerevan, Armenia, for the high-level segment of COP17 of the UN Convention on...
content: Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav reached Yerevan, Armenia, for the high-level segment of COP17 of the UN Convention on Biological Diversity — the first global review of progress under the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, which aims to halt and reverse biodiversity loss by 2030. He will highlight India’s conservation achievements at bilateral and multilateral meetings.

headline: India has invited Pakistan’s Federal Minister for National Heritage and Culture, Aurangzeb Khan Khichi, to the inaugural SCO...
content: India has invited Pakistan’s Federal Minister for National Heritage and Culture, Aurangzeb Khan Khichi, to the inaugural SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi from 20 to 22 November; Islamabad is yet to decide. The forum was proposed by PM Modi at the SCO summit in Tianjin in September 2025.

headline: Exit polls after Israel’s Knesset election showed no clear winner
content: Exit polls after Israel’s Knesset election showed no clear winner: Gadi Eisenkot’s opposition bloc was projected at 52–53 seats and PM Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc at 50, both short of the 61 needed, with Arab-led parties at a record 17–18. Netanyahu’s Likud (24–25 seats) is projected as the largest party, ahead of Eisenkot’s Yashar (21–23). Turnout was the highest since at least 1973; final results are expected by 30 October.

headline: US First Lady Melania Trump announced that the Russia-Ukraine ceasefire she brokered for the occupied Ukrainian city of...
content: US First Lady Melania Trump announced that the Russia-Ukraine ceasefire she brokered for the occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky took effect at 4 am Moscow time on 27 October, two days ahead of schedule, and has been expanded within the Kherson region to give humanitarian convoys safe passage. About 1,700–2,000 mostly elderly residents remain in the city; Russian strikes continued elsewhere in Ukraine.

headline: Ethiopia’s Orthodox Tewahedo Church said at least 60 Orthodox Christians were killed in two attacks in the Arsi Zone of...
content: Ethiopia’s Orthodox Tewahedo Church said at least 60 Orthodox Christians were killed in two attacks in the Arsi Zone of Oromia region — 14 in Merti district on 20 October and 46 in Shirka district on 24 October. The regional government blamed the Oromo Liberation Army (OLA), which could not be reached for comment.

headline: A UNFCCC synthesis of 127 new national climate plans (NDCs) found that global greenhouse gas emissions will fall only 6%...
content: A UNFCCC synthesis of 127 new national climate plans (NDCs) found that global greenhouse gas emissions will fall only 6% below 2019 levels by 2035 if current pledges are implemented — far off track from what is needed to limit warming.

headline: Bangladesh’s dengue death toll this year has reached 400, with 11 deaths in a single day
content: Bangladesh’s dengue death toll this year has reached 400, with 11 deaths in a single day — the highest daily toll of 2026 — and total cases at 1,28,237. Deaths of children with confirmed or suspected measles have risen to 1,240.

headline: Abhishek Sharma smashed 113 off 38 balls, with a 35-ball century, as India chased 199 in just 13.
content: Abhishek Sharma smashed 113 off 38 balls, with a 35-ball century, as India chased 199 in just 13.2 overs to beat New Zealand by six wickets in the third T20I at Wellington and take an unbeatable 3-0 lead in the five-match series. He and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi (45) put on 133 for the first wicket, including a record 118 in the powerplay; Daryl Mitchell had made 89 not out in NZ’s 198/3.

headline: India began the men’s Asian Champions Trophy hockey with a 13-0 win over Bangladesh in Jalandhar, with Mandeep Singh scoring...
content: India began the men’s Asian Champions Trophy hockey with a 13-0 win over Bangladesh in Jalandhar, with Mandeep Singh scoring a hat-trick. Midfielder Nilakanta Sharma announced he will retire from international hockey after the tournament; India play China on 29 October.

headline: Kajal Dhochak (76 kg) and Neelam Sirohi (50 kg) became the first two Indian women to reach the finals at the same World...
content: Kajal Dhochak (76 kg) and Neelam Sirohi (50 kg) became the first two Indian women to reach the finals at the same World Wrestling Championships. Kajal came back from 1-7 down to beat Kyrgyzstan’s Aiperi Medet Kyzy 10-7 and will face Ukraine’s Anastasiya Alpyeyeva, while Neelam beat Kazakhstan’s Zeinep Bayanova 7-3 to set up a final against Japan’s Yui Susaki.

headline: Aditya won India’s first gold of the World Under-19 Boxing Championships in Montenegro, beating Russia’s Islam Magomedov 4-1...
content: Aditya won India’s first gold of the World Under-19 Boxing Championships in Montenegro, beating Russia’s Islam Magomedov 4-1 in the 55 kg final. Harshika (65 kg) and Prachi Tokas (+80 kg) won bronze medals.

headline: England captain Harry Kane won the 2026 men’s Ballon d’Or
content: England captain Harry Kane won the 2026 men’s Ballon d’Or — the first Englishman since Michael Owen in 2001 — after scoring 73 goals for Bayern Munich, while Spain’s Alexia Putellas won the women’s award for the third time.

headline: India’s men stormed into the semi-finals of the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship in Ahmedabad with a 48-20 win...
content: India’s men stormed into the semi-finals of the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship in Ahmedabad with a 48-20 win over Tanzania, led by Neeraj Narwal’s 12 points. They face Sri Lanka in their last group match on 29 October.
